linkedin_post.call_to_action: Is your organization leveraging collaborative AI for demand forecasting? Share your thoughts below!
linkedin_post.text:
Forecasting is becoming a team sport. Is your supply chain ready?

By 2026, AI will move demand planning beyond your four walls. Expect more platforms to synchronize forecasting across partners—from suppliers to stores to DCs.

This shift transforms demand planning from a siloed guess into a shared effort, minimizing disruptions and improving service levels with shared live forecasts. AI analyzes historical data, market trends, and real-time signals for dynamic, continuously updated predictions—a leap from static, spreadsheet-driven planning.

Companies adopting AI for supply chain optimization are seeing real-time, multifactor forecasting that manages SKU proliferation and predicts demand shifts. This collaborative AI-driven foresight is key to navigating complexity and driving significant improvements in efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Is your organization leveraging collaborative AI for demand forecasting? Share your thoughts below!
